The 10th Hum Awards by Hum Network Limited, honored the best in fashion, music, and Hum Television Dramas of 2024. It took place on 11 October 2025 at the NRG Arena, Houston, Texas. The ceremony will televised in Pakistan by Hum TV. It was hosted by Mohib Mirza, Hareem Farooq, Hamza Sohail, Asim Azhar, Dananeer Mobeen, and Yasir Hussain.
Jafaa dominated the nominations with a total of 21, the highest for any series. It was followed by Zard Patton Ka Bunn with 15 nominations, while Namak Haraam and Ishq Murshid secured 14 nominations each. In terms of wins, Zard Patton Ka Bunn led the night with seven awards, followed closely by Ishq Murshid taking home six awards.
Winners & Nominees
On 1st September 2024, the nominations for the six viewers' choice categories were announced through the Network's website and official social media handles. The nominees were of the year 2024.
Winners are listed first and highlighted in boldface.
